title: THUMB Survival Anarchy Server
description: THUMB Survival Anarchy Server is a crossplay Minecraft server where Java and Bedrock players can play together in a anarchy world. No rules, no reset and PvP, raiding, building, and complete freedom.
body:
THUMB Survival Anarchy Server is a crossplay Minecraft server where Java and Bedrock players can play together in a anarchy world. No rules, no reset and PvP, raiding, building, and complete freedom.

Java Edition IP: 51.79.230.40:50019. Bedrock Edition IP: 51.79.230.40:50023 The server operates on all Minecraft versions from (26.1 to 1.9). Server is running on 26.1.2

It is recommended to use the Simple Voice Chat mod to speak to players in the server.
